senses.en: a person trained to treat sick or injured animals
to check someone or something carefully before giving approval

ex.en: The vet gently checked our puppy's ears and paws.
Organisations should vet potential employees carefully when recruiting people who will work with children or vulnerable adults.

col: take a pet to the vet｜đưa thú cưng đi khám bác sĩ thú y
vet applicants｜thẩm tra hồ sơ ứng viên
tip: Dạng quá khứ vetted, V-ing vetting, đều gấp đôi chữ t.

senses.en: people born and living at roughly the same time
the process of producing something, especially electricity
a stage in the development of a product or technology

ex.en: Three generations of our family gathered for dinner yesterday.
Each generation faces different challenges as technological progress changes the skills required in the workplace.

col: future generations｜các thế hệ tương lai
tip: Nghĩa “thế hệ” là danh từ đếm được; nghĩa “sự tạo ra” thường không đếm được.

senses.en: A place providing medical advice or treatment without overnight stays.

ex.en: The clinic near our house opens early on weekdays.
Local clinics can reduce pressure on hospitals by treating common illnesses and providing preventive care.

col: attend a clinic｜đi khám tại phòng khám
tip: clinic chỉ phòng khám; tính từ “thuộc lâm sàng” là clinical.

senses.en: to arrange for something to happen later than originally planned

ex.en: We postponed our picnic because heavy rain was forecast.
Local authorities decided to postpone construction until a full assessment of the environmental impact was completed.

col: postpone until further notice｜hoãn đến khi có thông báo mới
tip: Theo sau là danh từ hoặc V-ing: postpone doing, không dùng to do.

senses.en: a ceremonial headpiece worn by a king or queen

senses.zh: phong vương; trao danh hiệu vô địch
senses.en: to officially make someone a monarch or declare them champion
the highest part of a head, tree, or other object

ex.en: The queen wore a golden crown during the ceremony.
A royal crown displayed in a museum can reveal historical attitudes towards wealth, authority, and craftsmanship.

col: be crowned champion｜đoạt chức vô địch
the crown of the head｜đỉnh đầu
the crown of a tree｜tán cây
tip: be crowned champion nghĩa là “được trao danh hiệu vô địch”.

senses.zh: tội phạm; hoạt động phạm pháp
senses.en: illegal activities considered as a whole

senses.zh: tội ác; hành vi phạm tội
senses.en: an action that breaks the law

ex.en: Better street lighting has helped reduce crime here.
Investment in education and employment opportunities may reduce crime more effectively than increasingly severe punishments.

tip: Nghĩa chung “nạn tội phạm” không đếm được; chỉ một hành vi cụ thể thì đếm được, như commit a crime.

senses.en: to get away from confinement or a dangerous situation
to avoid something unpleasant or harmful

senses.zh: sự trốn thoát; sự thoát khỏi
senses.en: the act of getting free from danger or unpleasant conditions

ex.en: Our rabbit escaped through a small gap in the fence.
Accessible parks offer urban residents an escape from crowded streets and opportunities to enjoy nature.

col: escape from danger｜thoát khỏi nguy hiểm
narrow escape｜thoát nạn trong gang tấc
tip: Thoát khỏi một nơi dùng escape from; tránh được điều gì thì có thể nối trực tiếp với danh từ.

senses.en: Between basic and advanced levels, or between two stages.

senses.zh: người học trình độ trung cấp
senses.en: A learner whose skills are between beginner and advanced levels.

ex.en: This swimming class is suitable for intermediate learners.
Intermediate language courses should balance grammar instruction with opportunities for meaningful communication outside the classroom.

col: an intermediate course｜khóa học trung cấp
an intermediate stage｜giai đoạn trung gian
tip: Thường chỉ trình độ nằm giữa beginner và advanced.

senses.en: not cooked
in its original state before processing or analysis
sore because the skin is damaged or irritated

ex.en: I prefer raw carrots because they are so crunchy.
Countries that export mainly raw materials may be vulnerable to sudden changes in global commodity prices.

col: raw talent｜tài năng chưa được trau dồi
tip: raw nhấn mạnh chưa nấu hoặc chưa qua xử lý, không đồng nghĩa với “tươi” (fresh).

senses.en: the thick soft hair covering some animals
animal skin with hair attached, used for making clothing

ex.en: The cat's wet fur dried quickly in the sunshine.
Thick fur helps many mammals survive in cold climates by trapping a layer of warm air.

tip: Chỉ lông của động vật thường không đếm được; lông vũ của chim dùng feather.

senses.en: to officially allow someone to do something
an official document allowing a particular activity

senses.zh: làm cho có thể xảy ra
senses.en: to make an action or situation possible

ex.en: The museum permits visitors to take photos without flash.
Local authorities should permit new housing developments only when adequate transport and healthcare services are available.

col: permit someone to do something｜cho phép ai làm gì
weather permitting｜nếu thời tiết cho phép
tip: Động từ nhấn âm sau, danh từ nhấn âm đầu; permit sb to do.

senses.en: to take one number or amount away from another

ex.en: Subtract the delivery charge to find the original price.
Researchers subtract production costs from total revenue to calculate the profit generated by each farming method.

tip: subtract A from B nghĩa là lấy B trừ A.

senses.en: right for a particular person, purpose, or situation

ex.en: These walking shoes are suitable for muddy forest paths.
Cities should provide suitable housing for older residents, with easy access to healthcare and public transport.

col: suitable for children｜phù hợp với trẻ em
a suitable candidate｜ứng viên phù hợp
tip: Thường dùng suitable for sb/sth hoặc suitable to do sth.

senses.en: A tropical forest with thick, closely growing plants and trees

senses.zh: môi trường cạnh tranh khốc liệt
senses.en: A confusing or dangerous situation involving fierce competition

ex.en: Thick vines hung above the narrow jungle path.
Clearing jungle for agriculture destroys wildlife habitats and can reduce biodiversity across an entire region.

col: urban jungle｜rừng bê tông đô thị
tip: Thường chỉ rừng nhiệt đới rậm rạp; forest là từ chung cho rừng.

senses.zh: nhảy lò cò; nhảy chân sáo
senses.en: To jump on one foot or make small jumps.

senses.zh: cú nhảy lò cò; bước nhảy ngắn
senses.en: A small jump, especially one made on one foot.

senses.zh: nhảy lên hoặc xuống xe nhanh
senses.en: To get on or off a vehicle quickly and easily.

ex.en: The little bird hopped across the wet garden path.
Activities that encourage children to hop and balance can support physical development in early education.

col: hop on one foot｜nhảy lò cò
hop on a bus｜nhảy lên xe buýt
tip: Quá khứ hopped, V-ing hopping, cần gấp đôi chữ p.

senses.en: A vehicle that transports sick or injured people for medical care.

ex.en: An ambulance arrived quickly and took him to hospital.
Improving ambulance access in remote communities can reduce delays in treatment and increase patients' chances of recovery.

col: call an ambulance｜gọi xe cứu thương
ambulance service｜dịch vụ xe cứu thương
ambulance crew｜đội cấp cứu xe cứu thương
tip: Bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm nên dùng an ambulance; gọi xe cứu thương là call an ambulance.

senses.en: To establish that something is true or correct.

senses.zh: xác nhận lịch; chính thức phê chuẩn
senses.en: To make an arrangement certain or give it official approval.

ex.en: Please call the hotel to confirm our booking today.
Further research is needed to confirm whether smaller classes consistently improve learning outcomes in primary schools.

col: confirm a booking｜xác nhận đặt chỗ
confirm a diagnosis｜xác nhận chẩn đoán
tip: Có thể theo sau là danh từ hoặc mệnh đề that; không dùng confirm to do.

senses.en: A mountain with an opening that releases lava, ash, and gases

ex.en: We watched steam rising from the volcano across the lake.
Although an active volcano can threaten nearby communities, volcanic soils often provide valuable land for agriculture.

col: active volcano｜núi lửa đang hoạt động
a volcano erupts｜núi lửa phun trào
tip: Số nhiều là volcanoes hoặc volcanos đều được; phun trào dùng erupt.

senses.en: a small pointed metal object used to hold things together
to fasten something with a pin or similar object
to hold someone or something firmly so movement is impossible

ex.en: She used a pin to hold the fabric together.
Teachers can pin students' artwork to classroom walls to celebrate creativity and encourage participation.

col: pin something to｜ghim vật gì lên
pin down｜ghì chặt; xác định rõ
tip: Khi là động từ, quá khứ pinned, V-ing pinning.

senses.en: Used, owned, or experienced by more than one person
Gave others part of something or used something together

ex.en: Our shared kitchen gets busy around dinner time.
Shared responsibility for household tasks can reduce stress and improve relationships between family members.

tip: Vừa là tính từ, vừa là quá khứ hoặc quá khứ phân từ của share.

senses.en: at first, before later changes
in relation to where someone or something first came from

ex.en: This café was originally a small shop selling flowers.
Many buildings originally designed as factories have been converted into housing to meet growing urban demand.

col: originally planned｜được lên kế hoạch ban đầu
originally intended for｜ban đầu dành cho
tip: Chỉ tình trạng ban đầu, thường ngụ ý sau đó đã thay đổi; không đồng nghĩa với currently.

senses.en: To form an opinion after considering someone or something.
An official who oversees court proceedings and makes legal decisions.
Someone who assesses performances or decides the winner of a competition.

ex.en: Don't judge the soup until you have tasted it.
Schools should judge students on a range of abilities rather than relying entirely on examination results.

col: judge by appearances｜đánh giá qua vẻ bề ngoài
a panel of judges｜hội đồng giám khảo
a court judge｜thẩm phán tòa án
tip: judge A by B nghĩa là đánh giá A dựa trên B.

senses.en: something you should do because it is right or required
work required by a job or a period of service
a tax charged on certain goods

ex.en: It is my duty to keep these animals safe.
Governments have a duty to protect vulnerable citizens while ensuring that public services remain financially sustainable.

col: a sense of duty｜tinh thần trách nhiệm
carry out duties｜thực hiện nhiệm vụ
tip: on duty là đang trực; nhiệm vụ cụ thể của một vị trí thường dùng số nhiều duties.

senses.en: a formal request for a job, place, or permission
the practical use of knowledge, skills, or methods
a computer program designed to perform particular tasks

ex.en: I sent my job application before breakfast this morning.
Simplifying the application process could encourage more students from disadvantaged backgrounds to apply for university scholarships.

tip: Xin cái gì dùng application for; nộp cho tổ chức nào dùng to.

senses.en: A substance applied to skin to protect it from sunlight.

ex.en: Please put on sunscreen before we leave for the beach.
Using sunscreen alongside protective clothing can reduce skin damage caused by prolonged exposure to sunlight.

col: reapply sunscreen｜thoa lại kem chống nắng
water-resistant sunscreen｜kem chống nắng chống nước
tip: Thường không đếm được; thoa kem chống nắng dùng apply hoặc put on.

senses.en: A chemical element present in all living things.

ex.en: Diamonds and the graphite in pencils both contain carbon.
Protecting forests helps store carbon and reduces the amount of carbon dioxide released into the atmosphere.

tip: carbon là nguyên tố cacbon; carbon dioxide mới là khí CO2.

senses.zh: một cách trung thực; thẳng thắn
senses.en: In a truthful way, without lying or cheating.

senses.zh: thành thật mà nói; quả thật
senses.en: Used to emphasize sincerity or introduce a frank opinion.

ex.en: Please answer honestly: did you enjoy the soup?
Companies that communicate honestly about environmental challenges are more likely to earn lasting public trust.

tip: honestly nhấn mạnh sự trung thực; muốn nói “công bằng” thường dùng fairly.

senses.en: the period of life when someone is a child

ex.en: My happiest childhood memories involve baking with my grandmother.
Access to safe outdoor spaces during childhood can support physical development and emotional wellbeing.

col: a happy childhood｜tuổi thơ hạnh phúc
tip: during childhood nói chung về thời thơ ấu; in my childhood chỉ tuổi thơ của tôi.

senses.en: Having many connected parts and therefore difficult to understand or manage.

ex.en: This recipe is too complicated for a quick lunch.
Complicated application procedures may discourage eligible students from seeking financial support for their university studies.

col: complicated relationship｜mối quan hệ phức tạp
tip: Nhấn mạnh sự phức tạp, khó hiểu; complex đôi khi chỉ nói cấu trúc phức tạp.

senses.en: The short, thick finger on the side of your hand.
To turn pages quickly without reading everything carefully.

ex.en: I accidentally hit my thumb while hanging a picture.
Many readers thumb through printed magazines before deciding which articles deserve their full attention.

col: a thumbs-up｜giơ ngón cái tán thưởng
a rule of thumb｜quy tắc kinh nghiệm
tip: Chữ b không đọc; thumb through nghĩa là lật nhanh để xem lướt.

senses.en: someone who pays for professional services
a computer or program using services from a server

ex.en: The designer showed her client three possible kitchen layouts.
Maintaining clear communication with each client helps businesses build trust and establish lasting professional relationships.

col: client needs｜nhu cầu của khách hàng
client confidentiality｜bảo mật thông tin khách hàng
tip: client thường mua dịch vụ chuyên môn; customer là người mua hàng hóa hoặc dịch vụ nói chung.

senses.en: a strip of road for one line of vehicles
a narrow road, especially in the countryside
a marked strip for one swimmer or runner

ex.en: Our bus moved into the lane beside the pavement.
Dedicated cycle lanes can improve road safety and encourage more residents to travel by bicycle.

tip: lane là một làn đường; cả con đường thường dùng road.

senses.en: With an audible voice rather than silently.

ex.en: Please read the recipe aloud while I mix.
Reading stories aloud can help young children develop vocabulary and strengthen their understanding of spoken language.

tip: aloud nhấn mạnh phát ra tiếng, không nhất thiết to như loudly.

senses.en: An instrument used to measure temperature.

ex.en: She placed the thermometer gently under her son's tongue.
Accurate thermometers help researchers monitor temperature changes in natural habitats affected by global warming.

tip: Nhấn âm tiết thứ hai; đo thân nhiệt thường nói take someone's temperature.

senses.zh: quần áo cần giặt hoặc đã giặt
senses.en: Clothes and other fabrics waiting to be washed or freshly washed.

senses.zh: việc giặt giũ; tiệm giặt là
senses.en: The activity of washing clothes, or a place providing this service.

ex.en: Please put your dirty laundry in the basket.
Shared laundry facilities can reduce water consumption and save space in modern apartment buildings.

col: a laundry basket｜giỏ đựng đồ giặt
tip: Khi chỉ quần áo hoặc việc giặt giũ thì thường không đếm được.

senses.en: a small animal with a long, soft body and no legs
a harmful computer program that copies itself across networks

ex.en: A worm wriggled out of the wet garden soil.
Worms improve soil quality by breaking down organic matter and allowing air to circulate underground.

col: earthworms and other worms｜giun đất và các loại giun khác
a can of worms｜một mớ rắc rối
tip: worm là từ chung chỉ các loài giun; earthworm chỉ giun đất.

senses.en: Unable to think or act normally after drinking alcohol
So excited by something that sensible judgment is lost

senses.zh: người say rượu; kẻ nghiện rượu
senses.en: Someone who is drunk or frequently drinks too much alcohol

ex.en: He was too drunk to walk home safely.
Public awareness campaigns can help reduce accidents caused by drunk drivers, especially among younger adults.

col: drunk driving｜lái xe khi say rượu
drunk with power｜ngây ngất vì quyền lực
tip: drunk thường đứng sau động từ; đứng trước danh từ thường dùng drunken.

senses.zh: anh rể; em rể; anh em vợ/chồng
senses.en: your spouse's brother, or your sibling's or spouse's sibling's husband

ex.en: My brother-in-law helped my sister carry their new sofa upstairs.
Sharing childcare with relatives, such as a brother-in-law, can help working parents manage their daily responsibilities.

col: a future brother-in-law｜anh/em rể tương lai
tip: Số nhiều là brothers-in-law; không chỉ anh em họ.

senses.en: Very unhappy or uncomfortable
Extremely unpleasant or of very poor quality

ex.en: I felt miserable when rain ruined our picnic plans.
Overcrowded housing can create miserable living conditions and negatively affect residents' physical and mental health.

tip: Có thể tả tâm trạng con người, cũng có thể tả thời tiết hoặc điều kiện sống.

senses.en: A painful feeling caused by doing something wrong or embarrassing.
Something that causes disappointment or regret.
To make someone feel guilty or embarrassed about their behaviour.

ex.en: He felt shame after lying to his closest friend.
Schools should address bullying without creating a culture of shame that prevents pupils from seeking help.

col: a sense of shame｜cảm giác xấu hổ
shame someone into doing something｜làm ai xấu hổ mà phải làm gì
tip: Nghĩa “xấu hổ” thường không đếm được; It's a shame nghĩa là thật đáng tiếc.

senses.en: ready and happy to do something
eager to help or work without needing persuasion

ex.en: I'm willing to help you move this weekend.
Consumers may be more willing to buy sustainable products if prices remain affordable and information is clear.

col: be willing to do something｜sẵn lòng làm gì
a willing volunteer｜tình nguyện viên nhiệt tình
a willing helper｜người sẵn lòng giúp đỡ
tip: Thường dùng be willing to do, nghĩa là sẵn lòng, không phải “sắp sửa”.

senses.zh: cuộc sống về đêm; giải trí ban đêm
senses.en: Entertainment and social activities available in a place at night

ex.en: We enjoyed the city's nightlife after dinner by the river.
A vibrant nightlife can attract tourists and create jobs, but noise may disturb local residents.

col: vibrant nightlife｜cuộc sống về đêm sôi động
enjoy the nightlife｜tận hưởng cuộc sống về đêm
nightlife scene｜khung cảnh giải trí về đêm
tip: nightlife thường không đếm được, chỉ các hoạt động giải trí và giao lưu ban đêm.

senses.en: Covered with ice.
Extremely cold.
Showing no warmth or friendliness.

ex.en: We walked slowly along the icy path this morning.
Local authorities should treat icy roads promptly to reduce accidents and maintain reliable public transport.

col: an icy stare｜cái nhìn lạnh lùng
tip: icy chỉ bề mặt phủ băng hoặc cực lạnh, cũng dùng để tả thái độ lạnh nhạt.

senses.en: an amount of material covering a surface or another amount
to arrange things in sheets or levels over each other

ex.en: A thin layer of dust covered the shelf.
Adding an extra layer of insulation can significantly reduce energy consumption in older homes.

col: a layer of dust｜một lớp bụi
tip: “Một lớp cái gì” dùng a layer of; layer cũng có thể là động từ.

senses.zh: trang phục diễn; đồ hóa trang
senses.en: clothes worn to look like a particular character or creature

senses.zh: trang phục dân tộc; trang phục thời đại
senses.en: clothing typical of a particular country, culture, or historical period

ex.en: Lena wore a butterfly costume in the school play.
Traditional costume can express cultural identity and help younger generations understand the history of their communities.

col: a costume designer｜nhà thiết kế trang phục
tip: Chỉ trang phục của nhân vật hoặc nền văn hóa cụ thể, không chỉ quần áo hằng ngày.

senses.en: not common or not happening often
cooked briefly so the inside remains red

ex.en: We spotted a rare bird beside the lake yesterday.
Protecting rare species requires long-term investment in habitat restoration and effective controls on illegal trade.

tip: Khi tả thịt, rare nghĩa là bên trong còn đỏ, chín ít hơn medium.

senses.en: A thick mixture of flour and liquid used for baking.
Money, in informal speech.

ex.en: Mina kneaded the dough on a flour-covered kitchen table.
Allowing dough to rise slowly can improve bread quality without the need for artificial additives.

col: let the dough rise｜để bột nở
tip: Danh từ không đếm được; bột lỏng thường gọi là batter.

senses.en: Someone employed to carry luggage at hotels or stations.
Someone who controls entry to a building.

ex.en: The porter carried our heavy suitcases to the lift.
Hotels can improve accessibility by training each porter to assist guests with limited mobility.

col: hotel porter｜nhân viên khuân hành lý khách sạn
night porter｜người gác cửa ca đêm
tip: Không phải là “phục vụ” nói chung; thường chỉ người khuân hành lý hoặc người gác cửa.

senses.en: The absence of something or not having enough of it
Not have something necessary or enough of it

ex.en: A lack of sleep made me tired all morning.
Many rural schools lack the resources needed to provide students with practical science lessons.

col: a lack of resources｜thiếu tài nguyên
for lack of funding｜vì thiếu kinh phí
tip: Danh từ dùng a lack of; động từ nối thẳng với tân ngữ, không thêm of.

senses.zh: sự thất bại; điều thất bại
senses.en: a lack of success, or something that does not succeed

senses.zh: sự hỏng hóc; sự suy kiệt
senses.en: a situation in which a machine or organ stops working

senses.zh: việc không làm; sự không thực hiện
senses.en: not doing something that is expected or required

ex.en: Despite her first failure, she tried baking bread again.
Schools should treat failure as an opportunity for learning rather than as evidence of a student's limited ability.

col: end in failure｜kết thúc trong thất bại
tip: Nghĩa “thất bại” nói chung thường không đếm được; a failure có thể chỉ một sự việc thất bại.

senses.en: Unable to hear, or able to hear very little.

ex.en: My deaf cousin taught me some useful everyday signs.
Providing captions and sign language interpretation can make public information more accessible to deaf people.

tip: Phát âm giống def; Deaf viết hoa nhấn mạnh bản sắc văn hóa của cộng đồng người điếc.

senses.zh: sự nghi ngờ; sự không chắc chắn
senses.en: A feeling of uncertainty about whether something is true or possible.

senses.zh: nghi ngờ; cho là khó xảy ra
senses.en: To feel uncertain about something or think it unlikely.

ex.en: I doubt the shop is still open this late.
There is little doubt that access to clean water is essential for improving public health.

col: no doubt｜không còn nghi ngờ gì
cast doubt on｜gây nghi ngờ về
beyond doubt｜không còn nghi ngờ gì nữa
tip: Chữ b không đọc; I doubt that thường diễn tả cho rằng điều gì khó xảy ra.

senses.en: feeling ill or not in good health

ex.en: I felt unwell and went home before lunch.
Employees who feel unwell should be encouraged to stay home to prevent infections spreading at work.

col: become unwell｜bắt đầu thấy không khỏe
slightly unwell｜hơi khó chịu trong người
tip: Thường đứng sau feel hoặc be làm vị ngữ, ít đứng trước danh từ.

senses.en: existing at the beginning, before any changes
new and different rather than copied from something else
the first version from which copies are made

ex.en: The kitchen still has its original wooden floor.
Schools should encourage original thinking rather than reward students only for repeating information from textbooks.

tip: Có thể nghĩa là “ban đầu” hoặc “độc đáo”; dựa vào ngữ cảnh để phân biệt.

senses.en: Tell someone you are pleased about their success or good fortune.

ex.en: We called to congratulate Lina on her new job.
Schools should congratulate students on personal improvement rather than focus exclusively on high examination scores.

col: congratulate someone on something｜chúc mừng ai về điều gì
congratulate someone warmly｜nhiệt liệt chúc mừng ai
tip: Dùng congratulate sb on sth, giới từ không phải for.

senses.en: The activity of eating a meal

ex.en: We moved the dining table closer to the window.
Shared dining spaces in student accommodation can encourage social interaction and help newcomers develop a sense of belonging.

tip: Cũng là V-ing của dine; dining chỉ có một chữ n.

senses.en: to collect things from different places or sources
to come together or bring people together
to understand something from what you hear or observe

ex.en: We gathered fallen apples in a basket before lunch.
Researchers gather information from local residents to understand how public transport affects access to employment.

tip: I gather that... nghĩa là “tôi nghe nói” hoặc “tôi suy ra rằng...”.

senses.en: A period of two weeks.

ex.en: We're spending a fortnight by the sea this summer.
Allowing employees to work remotely for a fortnight could help employers evaluate the benefits of flexible working.

col: once a fortnight｜hai tuần một lần
tip: Chủ yếu dùng trong tiếng Anh Anh; tiếng Anh Mỹ thường nói two weeks.

senses.zh: bất cứ điều gì; dù là gì
senses.en: anything that; no matter what

senses.zh: bất kỳ loại nào; bất cứ
senses.en: any kind of something, without restriction

ex.en: You can choose whatever you like for dinner tonight.
Whatever their background, students should have equal access to high-quality education and appropriate learning support.

col: whatever happens｜dù chuyện gì xảy ra
whatever the reason｜dù lý do là gì
whatever you like｜bất cứ điều gì bạn thích
tip: whatever không giới hạn phạm vi; whichever thường chỉ chọn bất kỳ trong phạm vi đã giới hạn.

senses.en: A person connected to you by blood or marriage.
Judged by comparison rather than by a fixed standard.

ex.en: A relative brought us homemade bread during the holidays.
The relative cost of public transport influences whether residents choose buses over private cars.

col: relative importance｜tầm quan trọng tương đối
tip: Là danh từ thì chỉ họ hàng; là tính từ thường đi với to để so sánh.

senses.en: As an unavoidable result or something that must be true

ex.en: An expensive coat is not necessarily a warmer one.
Economic growth does not necessarily improve living standards unless its benefits are shared widely across society.

tip: not necessarily nghĩa là “không nhất thiết”, không phải “chắc chắn không”.

senses.en: To move continuously, like water through a channel.
Continuous movement, or the amount moving through a place.

ex.en: Rainwater flowed down the path and into the garden.
Improved public transport can ease the flow of traffic and reduce air pollution in crowded cities.

tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là flowed, không phải flew.

senses.zh: người được đào tạo; thực tập sinh
senses.en: Someone learning the skills needed for a particular job.

ex.en: The trainee watched carefully as the chef chopped vegetables.
Assigning an experienced mentor to each trainee can improve workplace learning and reduce costly mistakes.

col: management trainee｜thực tập sinh quản lý
graduate trainee｜nhân viên tập sự là sinh viên mới tốt nghiệp
tip: trainee là người được đào tạo; trainer là người đào tạo người khác.

senses.en: to take hold of something suddenly or firmly
to get food, drink, or something else quickly
to attract someone's attention strongly

ex.en: She grabbed her umbrella and ran towards the bus.
Public health campaigns often use striking images to grab attention and encourage people to change unhealthy habits.

col: grab someone's attention｜thu hút sự chú ý của ai
grab a bite｜ăn vội chút gì
grab an opportunity｜nắm bắt cơ hội
tip: grab khá thông tục; quá khứ grabbed, V-ing grabbing.

senses.en: producing the intended or desired result
officially in force from a particular time
existing in practice, even if not officially recognised

ex.en: This simple stretch is effective at easing shoulder tension.
Effective environmental policies should combine clear regulations with financial incentives that encourage businesses to reduce waste.

col: effective in doing something｜hiệu quả trong việc làm gì
tip: effective nhấn mạnh đạt được kết quả; efficient nhấn mạnh tiết kiệm thời gian và công sức.

senses.en: Often or many times

ex.en: Our neighbour frequently brings us vegetables from her garden.
People who frequently use public transport may spend less on travel than those who drive daily.

col: frequently asked questions｜các câu hỏi thường gặp
tip: Thường đặt trước động từ thường, sau động từ be; gần nghĩa với often.

senses.en: To become aware of something or understand it clearly
To make a hope happen or achieve possible success

ex.en: I realized I had left my keys at home.
Affordable training can help young people realize their potential and gain access to more rewarding careers.

col: realize a dream｜thực hiện ước mơ
realize your potential｜phát huy tiềm năng của bạn
tip: Anh Anh cũng viết realise; nhận ra điều gì có thể dùng mệnh đề that.

senses.en: shout happily to show approval or encouragement

senses.zh: tiếng reo hò; tiếng cổ vũ
senses.en: a loud shout expressing happiness, approval, or encouragement

senses.zh: làm phấn chấn; làm vui lên
senses.en: make someone feel happier or more hopeful

ex.en: We cheered as our neighbour crossed the finish line.
When spectators cheer for every participant, community sporting events can foster a stronger sense of belonging.

col: cheer someone up｜làm ai vui lên
a loud cheer｜tiếng reo hò lớn
cheer for a team｜cổ vũ cho đội
tip: cheer on là cổ vũ; cheer up là vui lên hoặc làm ai vui lên.

senses.en: At the present time, especially compared with the past.

ex.en: Nowadays, I usually pay for groceries with my phone.
Nowadays, many employees expect flexible working arrangements that allow them to balance professional and family responsibilities.

col: nowadays, many people｜ngày nay nhiều người
more common nowadays｜ngày nay phổ biến hơn
rarely used nowadays｜ngày nay hiếm khi được dùng
tip: Thường dùng với thì hiện tại đơn, nhấn mạnh sự đối chiếu xưa nay; không cần thêm giới từ.

senses.en: A sweet substance chewed but not swallowed
The firm pink flesh surrounding the bases of teeth
A sticky substance from plants, often used for making glue

ex.en: She offered me a piece of mint gum.
Regular dental checkups can help detect gum disease before it causes serious damage.

col: a piece of gum｜một miếng kẹo cao su
tip: Kẹo cao su là danh từ không đếm được; lợi thường dùng số nhiều gums.

senses.en: all people living in an area, or their total number
all organisms of one species living in a particular area

ex.en: The village population grows when families move here.
An ageing population can place additional pressure on healthcare systems and increase demand for accessible public transport.

tip: Dân số đông hoặc ít dùng large hoặc small, không dùng many hoặc few.

senses.en: an organisation that helps people or causes in need

senses.zh: lòng từ thiện; sự cứu trợ
senses.en: help, especially money, given to those in need

ex.en: My sister volunteers at a charity that rescues dogs.
Local charities can provide essential support, but governments remain responsible for ensuring access to basic services.

col: donate to charity｜quyên góp cho từ thiện
raise money for charity｜gây quỹ từ thiện
tip: Chỉ tổ chức thì đếm được; chỉ hoạt động từ thiện hoặc cứu trợ thì không đếm được.

senses.en: A soft filled bag used for comfort or support.

senses.zh: giảm chấn; làm dịu tác động
senses.en: To soften an impact or reduce a harmful effect.
Something that protects against difficulty, loss, or sudden change.

ex.en: She put a soft cushion behind her back.
Emergency savings can cushion the financial impact of unemployment and help families maintain their living standards.

col: financial cushion｜khoản dự phòng tài chính
tip: Động từ thường đi với impact hoặc blow, nghĩa là giảm sốc.

senses.zh: dời đi; lấy ra; cởi ra
senses.en: to take something away from where it is
to get rid of something unwanted
to make someone leave a job or position

ex.en: Please remove your shoes before stepping onto the new carpet.
Governments should remove unnecessary barriers that prevent qualified workers from entering the labour market.

col: remove someone from office｜cách chức ai
tip: Thường dùng remove A from B, nghĩa là loại bỏ A khỏi B.

senses.en: the main subject or idea in a work or discussion

senses.zh: nhạc chủ đề; giai điệu chính
senses.en: a recognisable tune associated with a programme or musical work

ex.en: We chose a seaside theme for the birthday party.
The relationship between economic growth and environmental protection is a central theme in contemporary public debate.

tip: theme thiên về tư tưởng xuyên suốt tác phẩm; topic thường là đề tài thảo luận.

senses.en: mention someone or something, or have them as the meaning
look at a source to find information
send someone or something elsewhere for expert help or consideration

ex.en: Please refer to the map inside your guidebook.
Doctors may refer patients to specialists when their symptoms require more detailed investigation or treatment.

col: refer to a report｜tham khảo hoặc đề cập đến báo cáo
refer to something as｜gọi cái gì là
refer someone to a specialist｜giới thiệu ai đến bác sĩ chuyên khoa
tip: Thường đi với to; quá khứ referred, V-ing referring.

senses.en: Apart from others, or individually rather than together.

ex.en: We paid separately, then walked home together after lunch.
Households should collect food waste separately so that local authorities can process it into compost more efficiently.

tip: Tách khỏi cái gì dùng separately from, không dùng with.

senses.en: Lasting for only a limited period of time.

ex.en: This temporary desk will do until the new one arrives.
Temporary accommodation provides essential shelter while families wait for suitable permanent housing to become available.

tip: Nhấn mạnh thời gian có hạn; từ trái nghĩa là permanent.

senses.en: relating to crime or the legal treatment of crime
a person who has committed a crime

ex.en: The police found evidence of criminal activity in the warehouse.
Education and employment programmes may reduce criminal behaviour by providing young people with better opportunities.

col: criminal justice system｜hệ thống tư pháp hình sự
tip: criminal có thể là tính từ hoặc danh từ; crime nghĩa là “tội ác”.

senses.en: a prehistoric reptile, often large, known mainly from fossils
a person or thing considered outdated and resistant to change

ex.en: We saw a huge dinosaur skeleton at the museum.
Studying dinosaur fossils helps researchers understand how ancient environments differed from those of the present day.

col: dinosaur extinction｜sự tuyệt chủng của khủng long
tip: Khi dùng ẩn dụ chỉ người hoặc tổ chức lạc hậu thì mang sắc thái chê, nên thận trọng trong văn cảnh trang trọng.

senses.en: Make someone interested in or drawn towards something
Pull something closer through a physical force

ex.en: The bright flowers attract butterflies to our small balcony.
Cities that invest in reliable public transport are more likely to attract businesses and skilled workers.

col: attract attention｜thu hút sự chú ý
tip: attract là ngoại động từ, nối thẳng với người hoặc vật làm tân ngữ.

senses.en: to interrupt, annoy, or worry someone
to make the effort to do something
trouble or effort that causes inconvenience

ex.en: Please do not bother your sister while she studies.
Constant notifications can bother students during lessons and reduce their ability to concentrate on complex tasks.

col: bother someone with something｜làm phiền ai bằng việc gì
bother to do something｜bận tâm làm gì
cannot be bothered｜lười không buồn làm
a lot of bother｜rất nhiều phiền toái
tip: bother to do thường dùng ở câu phủ định hoặc nghi vấn, nghĩa là bận tâm làm gì.

senses.en: A fight between armed forces.

senses.zh: cuộc đấu tranh; nỗ lực gian khổ
senses.en: A difficult struggle to achieve something or overcome a problem.

senses.zh: đấu tranh quyết liệt; chiến đấu
senses.en: To struggle hard against someone or something.

ex.en: The museum displays armour from a famous battle.
The battle against air pollution requires coordinated action from governments, businesses, and individuals across urban areas.

col: an uphill battle｜cuộc đấu tranh gian nan
battle against pollution｜đấu tranh chống ô nhiễm
battle for survival｜đấu tranh để sinh tồn
tip: battle có thể chỉ trận chiến cụ thể, cũng thường dùng ẩn dụ cho việc chống bệnh tật hoặc khó khăn.

senses.en: Not needed or serving no useful purpose.

ex.en: Bring a light jacket, but heavy boots are unnecessary.
Clear instructions can prevent unnecessary delays and help public services operate more efficiently.

col: unnecessary expense｜chi phí không cần thiết
unnecessary stress｜căng thẳng không cần thiết
avoid unnecessary delays｜tránh những chậm trễ không cần thiết
tip: Muốn nói “không cần làm” có thể dùng it is unnecessary to do.

senses.zh: trò chơi trí tuệ; xếp hình
senses.en: A game or problem that tests your thinking skills.
Something that is difficult to understand or explain.
To make someone feel confused because something is difficult to understand.

ex.en: We finished the puzzle together on the kitchen table.
The relationship between income and personal happiness remains a puzzle that researchers approach from several different perspectives.

col: puzzle over something｜nghĩ nát óc về điều gì
tip: puzzled tả người thấy bối rối; puzzling tả sự việc gây bối rối.

senses.en: To make something less enjoyable, useful, or attractive.
To give someone excessive attention or everything they want.
To become, or make food become, unfit to eat.

ex.en: Please don't spoil the surprise by telling your sister.
Poorly planned construction can spoil natural landscapes and reduce their appeal to both residents and tourists.

col: spoil the surprise｜phá hỏng sự bất ngờ
spoil a child｜chiều hư đứa trẻ
spoil your appetite｜làm mất cảm giác thèm ăn
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ có thể là spoiled hoặc spoilt.

senses.en: To lose blood from a wound or inside the body.

ex.en: My finger started to bleed after a small paper cut.
First aid courses teach people how to respond safely when minor injuries cause someone to bleed.

tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là bled; blood là danh từ “máu”.

senses.en: An organised group of people who sing together.

ex.en: My sister sings in the choir every Sunday.
Joining a community choir can reduce loneliness and strengthen social connections among older adults.

col: join a choir｜tham gia dàn hợp xướng
tip: Phát âm gần như quire, bắt đầu không phải âm /ch/ thông thường.

senses.en: An important or basic part of something.
A substance that cannot be chemically divided into simpler substances.
Strong wind, rain, or other difficult weather conditions.

ex.en: Fresh herbs are a key element of this soup.
Public trust is an essential element of any successful policy aimed at improving community health.

col: a key element｜yếu tố then chốt
a chemical element｜nguyên tố hóa học
exposure to the elements｜phơi mình trước mưa gió
tip: Chỉ sức mạnh tự nhiên như mưa gió thường dùng the elements.

senses.zh: sáng tạo; có óc sáng tạo
senses.en: Able to produce original ideas, or involving imagination.

ex.en: My creative sister turned old jars into colourful lamps.
Schools should encourage creative thinking by allowing students to explore several solutions to the same problem.

col: a creative solution｜giải pháp sáng tạo
tip: Tả người có óc sáng tạo hoặc phương pháp mới mẻ; danh từ là creativity.

senses.zh: đi thuyền; chèo thuyền; đi tàu
senses.en: Travel across water in a boat or ship.
A large sheet of material that catches wind to move boats.

ex.en: We sailed across the lake on a sunny afternoon.
Ships that sail through sensitive marine habitats should follow strict rules to protect wildlife.

col: sail across the ocean｜đi thuyền vượt đại dương
tip: Khi là động từ không chỉ dùng cho thuyền buồm mà cả tàu thủy.

senses.en: December 26, a public holiday in Britain and several other countries.

ex.en: We usually eat leftover turkey together on Boxing Day.
Boxing Day sales can boost retail revenue, but they also raise concerns about unnecessary consumption.

col: on Boxing Day｜vào Ngày lễ tặng quà
Boxing Day sales｜đợt giảm giá Ngày lễ tặng quà
a Boxing Day walk｜buổi đi dạo Ngày lễ tặng quà
tip: Cố định chỉ ngày 26/12; viết hoa chữ cái đầu, không dùng dấu gạch nối.
note: Đã đổi cách viết không chuẩn boxing-day thành Boxing Day.

senses.zh: vụ giết người; tội sát nhân
senses.en: the crime of deliberately and unlawfully killing someone
to deliberately and unlawfully kill someone

ex.en: We watched a film about a detective investigating a murder.
Accurate forensic evidence plays a crucial role in solving murder cases and preventing wrongful convictions.

col: murder investigation｜điều tra vụ giết người
be charged with murder｜bị buộc tội giết người
tip: murder nhấn mạnh giết người cố ý và bất hợp pháp; kill có nghĩa rộng hơn.

senses.en: An area defined by its features or official boundaries.

ex.en: We found a small bakery in the old market district.
Improving public transport in suburban districts can reduce car dependence and widen access to employment.

tip: Có thể là đơn vị hành chính, cũng có thể là khu vực có chức năng riêng.

senses.zh: khác nhau; có sự khác biệt
senses.en: To be unlike something else in one or more ways.
To have a different opinion from another person.

ex.en: These jackets differ in price, but both look great.
Educational priorities differ between countries because economic conditions and cultural expectations shape national policies.

col: differ in size｜khác nhau về kích cỡ
differ with someone｜bất đồng ý kiến với ai
tip: from đưa ra đối tượng so sánh, in đưa ra phương diện khác biệt.

senses.en: affecting or involving most people, things, or situations
describing main points rather than particular details
an officer with a very high rank in the army

ex.en: There was general agreement that the kitchen needed repainting.
Although the general standard of education has improved, significant differences remain between urban and rural schools.

tip: in general nghĩa là “nói chung”, thường dùng để khái quát.

senses.en: a thick cloud near the ground that limits visibility

senses.zh: làm mờ; bị mờ đi vì hơi nước
senses.en: to become or make a surface covered with fine droplets

ex.en: Thick fog hid the hills behind our house.
Dense fog can disrupt transport networks, causing flight cancellations and increasing the risk of road accidents.

tip: fog dày hơn mist; fog up thường chỉ kính bị mờ hơi nước.

senses.en: To consider someone or something responsible for a problem.
Responsibility for something bad that has happened.

ex.en: Don't blame me for the broken kitchen chair.
It is unfair to blame individuals alone for environmental problems caused partly by industrial activity.

col: blame someone for something｜trách ai vì điều gì
blame something on someone｜đổ lỗi điều gì cho ai
be to blame｜phải chịu trách nhiệm
tip: Tân ngữ là người dùng blame sb for; tân ngữ là việc dùng blame sth on.

senses.en: Used when expecting others to agree that something is true
Certainly, or in a way that will achieve a result

ex.en: Surely you can spare five minutes to help?
Surely governments should prioritise clean drinking water before investing public money in expensive sports facilities.

col: will surely lead to｜chắc chắn sẽ dẫn đến
tip: Là phó từ; đầu câu thường diễn tả mong người nghe đồng tình.

senses.zh: trung học; thuộc giáo dục trung học
senses.en: Relating to education after primary school and before higher education.
Less important than something else.

ex.en: My sister starts secondary school after the summer holidays.
Access to quality secondary education can improve employment prospects for young people in rural communities.

col: of secondary importance｜có tầm quan trọng thứ yếu
tip: Nghĩa “thứ yếu so với” dùng secondary to, không dùng secondary than.
